title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43 and 53 Grade) — Specification
titleHi: साधारण पोर्टलैंड सीमेंट (33, 43 और 53 ग्रेड) — विशिष्‍टि
scope: Covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement in 33 Grade, 43 Grade, and 53 Grade.
scopeHi: यह मानक 33, 43 और 53 ग्रेड के साधारण पोर्टलैंड सीमेंट (ओपीसी) के रासायनिक और संपीड़न सामर्थ्य मानकों को नियंत्रित करता है।

keyTests.name: Compressive Strength (28 Days)
keyTests.parameterLimit: Grade 53: Min 53.0 MPa at 28 days; Grade 43: Min 43.0 MPa

keyTests.name: Initial and Final Setting Time
keyTests.parameterLimit: Initial setting time ≥ 30 min; Final setting time ≤ 600 min

markingRequirements: IS 269, ISI Mark, CM/L number, Grade of cement (e.g. OPC 53), Net weight (50 kg), Week/Month/Year of manufacture.
consumerTips: Never use cement bags older than 90 days from packaging date without re-testing strength.
industryGuidelines: Insoluble residue ≤ 5.0% and total sulfur content (as SO3) ≤ 3.5%.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.content: Compressive strength of mortar cubes shall not be less than 53 MPa at 28 days for 53 Grade OPC.
clauses.contentHi: 53 ग्रेड ओपीसी के लिए 28 दिनों में शक्ति 53 MPa से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए।

demoNotice: SAMPLE/DEMO DATA — Modeled closely after official Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for demonstration purposes.
